secrets.name: The Staff Room
secrets.text: Behind the shelves of the shop next door, the service corridor, and at the end of it the staff room: lockers, a kettle, a rota on the wall with every shift filled in for ever. A coat is on the back of a chair. Somebody is on their break. Somebody is always on their break.

meta.label: The Mall
meta.blurb: A shopping mall, two floors of it, under skylights: a fountain, escalators, and shop after shop after shop, all open, all lit, all selling the same thing. Books. There is nobody behind any of the counters.
